cycles.method: measured: executed ColdFire instructions under ot_emu --mkii (verify.py's worst case: every scene byte of all eight tracks locked in both scenes, the blend at fader 64, 201 writes), YES press to toast. No static bound: the per-write cost is stock's store and redraw. Budget: 100 ms at 266 MHz, a key-press responsiveness target.

load.method: Not run: APPLY SCENE does nothing in the frame interrupt or on MIDI; it runs once per key press in the UI task. A cfmeter.py flood comparison would measure no module code.
